name: wrapped-firstLastGraphBimodalClassPrefix-repeat
query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'android.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) STARTS WITH 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.'
RETURN DISTINCT n.graph_id, n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS callerMethod,
    n.callee_class AS callee, n.callee_name AS calleeMethod
LIMIT 250

name: global-wide-wrapped-case-insensitive-distinct-dense-repeat
query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get' OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200
